meaning: Stage 2, group 2: God is immutable (ST I q.9 a.1). Composes CATHOLICISM-STAGE2-GOD-IS-PERFECT: were God moved in some respect, a mover in act in it would move him (prima via), so God, perfect, would be in act in that respect, and being moved in it, in potency in it, which the prima via excludes. This combines q.9 a.1's first reason (what is changed is in potency) and third (the perfect acquires nothing).
